definitions.explanation: To become deeper or more profound.

examples.japanese: {友情|ゆうじょう}が{深|ふか}まった。
{話|はな}し{合|あ}いを{重|かさ}ねて、お{互|たが}いの{理解|りかい}が{深|ふか}まった。
examples.english: Through repeated discussions, our mutual understanding deepened.

notes:
{深|ふか}まる is an intransitive godan verb meaning something becomes deeper or more profound on its own.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive): {深|ふか}まる - something deepens
- {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive): {深|ふか}める - to deepen something

ASPECT (ている):
{深|ふか}まっている indicates a state of being deepened or intensified.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋|あき}が{深|ふか}まる: autumn advances/deepens
- {夜|よる}が{深|ふか}まる: night grows late
- {理解|りかい}が{深|ふか}まる: understanding deepens
- {友情|ゆうじょう}が{深|ふか}まる: friendship deepens
- {疑惑|ぎわく}が{深|ふか}まる: suspicion deepens

Often used for abstract concepts (relationships, emotions, seasons) rather than physical depth.
